Hi Hannah,

We finished the onboarding questionnaire for Greenline (submission attached) but our portal shows a provisional token instead of a formal PO code. - Requested spend cap: $120,000/year
- Expected PO (per our procurement): PO-992144 (we were told this would be applied during onboarding)

Also, the line items in the intake got collapsed (hardware + services grouped into one line) — we need them split so our cost center mapping is accurate.

Attaching: onboarding-form.pdf (filled intake), screenshot of supplier dashboard (inline).

Thanks,

Hi Jamie — thanks for the note and the attachment.

Short answer: STG-56821 looks like a staging token the onboarding system assigned when the intake completed before procurement/finance ran final issuance. We should be able to move you to the final PO, but I need to confirm two things from our side:

1) Finance needs to verify the spend cap and whether the account requires an escrow hold or temporary limit while we reconcile line items.
2) Procurement/Platform needs the intake broken into explicit lines (hardware, license, services) so the PO maps to your cost centers as requested.

Monica — can you pull the PO issuance log and confirm whether PO-992144 exists in our ledger, or whether that PO was reserved in a separate system?
Karthik — can you advise whether we can push a provisional override so Greenline's provisioning isn't blocked?

Jamie — if you can send a quick CSV of the line-item breakdown (three rows: hardware, license, services) I will prioritize the move. If you're OK with a provisional PO we can temporarily allow STG-56821 to be used for onboarding and swap it for the final PO once finance signs off. That path is usually fastest.

Best,
Hannah
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
message_3:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: missing PO code on intake form

Hannah — dug into the issuance logs. Notes below, pasted from the issuance audit:

- STG-56821: provisional token generated by onboarding service on 2026-09-26T10:12:45Z (status: ACTIVE, type: PROVISIONAL)
- PO-992144: reserved in procurement queue on 2026-09-25 by Greenline request but not yet stamped into the master ledger (status: PENDING_STAMP)

Problem: the intake pipeline quietly merged hardware and software lines when the form came through. Our PO stamping job uses the line hashes to allocate spend buckets; because the hash changed the job didn't stamp PO-992144 — it left the provisional token in place. I've attached the extraction of the PO assignment log (ponum-log.csv) with the mismatch row highlighted.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Approve a temporary spend-cap override to unblock provisioning (we set provisional spend cap to $30k for first 30 days while finance completes verification).
2) I will run a manual re-stamp for PO-992144 once Greenline provides the CSV with the explicit 3-line breakdown (hardware/license/services) — that will allow the job to match the expected hash and push the final PO into the ledger.
3) After stamping, we'll schedule a quick reconciliation to move any committed charges from STG-56821 to PO-992144 and annotate the ledger row with the correct cost-centers.

Marcus — finance side: can you confirm whether a 30-day provisional cap of $30,000 is acceptable for this vendor to avoid blocking onboarding? If not, what is the minimum you can approve to allow initial provisioning?

Attachments: ponum-log.csv, provisional-po-stub.txt

Thanks,
Monica
Vendor Enablement Lead
